question: Select the inference(s) that best follow(s) from the statements given below. Statements: Megan ordered shoes from an online store after checking their size chart. When she tried the shoes on, none of them fit. She returned the shoes. Inferences: The sizes on the store’s size chart are different to the sizes of the shoes. There are no shoes in the store that fit Megan. A. Only inference I follows. B. Only inference II follows. C. Both inferences I and II follow. D. Neither inference I nor II follows.
